ask: Keep useful knowledge across sessions and machines.
plugin: An MCP memory store indexes project facts and retrieves relevant items; a skill and hooks maintain provenance and sync.

ask: Save and recover task context before compaction, clearing, or session loss.
plugin: A PreCompact hook and transcript monitor write task checkpoints and summaries; a resume command reloads them.

ask: Show and manage how context is spent.
plugin: A statusline and monitor estimate context use and tool output cost; a command reports the breakdown.

ask: Reduce context bloat and control compaction behavior.
plugin: Experimental function hooks filter tool history or reminders and veto compaction; skills checkpoint before limits.

ask: Find, name, group, export, and resume local Claude Code sessions.
plugin: A bin indexer reads local JSONL transcripts and provides search, rename aliases, grouping, and markdown export commands.

ask: Monitor several local Claude Code sessions and their state.
plugin: A monitor reads session transcripts, process state, and project metadata for a local dashboard and statusline.

ask: Queue prompts and steer work while Claude is running.
plugin: A function hook or local inbox queues user prompts and injects them at safe lifecycle boundaries; a command manages the queue.

ask: Provide safer multiline input, editor handoff, and customizable terminal keys.
plugin: A bin launcher or experimental function hook manages prompt editing, submission keys, and editor round trips.

ask: Make terminal prompts easier to compose and navigate.
plugin: A function hook supplies custom completions and controlled suggestion acceptance in the prompt UI.

ask: Improve readability and navigation in terminal conversations.
plugin: An output style, theme, and experimental function hook adjust rendering, separators, visual states, and keyboard navigation.

ask: Display project and work progress in terminal titles and OS indicators.
plugin: A statusline, monitor, and terminal escape sequences update the window title and progress indicator.

ask: Show branch, model, mode, context, and activity in a custom statusline.
plugin: A statusline command combines hook data, local git state, and transcript metrics.

ask: Show session, agent, and skill token costs and usage warnings.
plugin: A monitor parses local session transcripts and telemetry for per-turn, per-agent, and per-skill reports and alerts.

ask: Choose models and effort by task, prompt, or stage and report fallback.
plugin: A launch command selects a model; experimental function hooks route model requests and detect fallback.

ask: Store, name, organize, export, and compare plans by project.
plugin: A command and hooks copy accepted plans into project storage with descriptive names and diffs.

ask: Improve plan presentation, approval, and follow-through.
plugin: A planning skill and Stop hook check execution against the accepted plan; experimental function hooks adjust plan transitions and approval UI.

ask: Apply relevant project rules and skills at the right time.
plugin: A skill index and hooks select applicable rules from directories and inject them before tool use or delegation.

ask: Check work against explicit requirements before declaring it done.
plugin: A skill and Stop hook extract requirements, verify changed files and tests, and block unsupported completion claims.

ask: Run independent code review and preserve findings.
plugin: A review agent checks diffs against requirements and stores findings in an MCP ledger for later audits.

ask: Manage safe worktree branches, selective checkout, and git safeguards.
plugin: A command creates and tracks worktrees; PreToolUse hooks guard destructive git operations and enforce branch policy.

ask: Run shell commands with scoped timeouts, wrappers, and permission rules.
plugin: A Bash PreToolUse hook checks command patterns, deadlines, and wrappers; a bin command runs approved commands.

ask: Apply fine-grained file, tool, and task approval policies.
plugin: PreToolUse and PermissionRequest settings hooks validate path and parameter scopes and delegate approvals to configured reviewers.

ask: Protect secrets and personal data sent to tools and networks.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook scans file reads, web queries, and outbound tool inputs against a secret and PII policy.

ask: Compose reusable event hooks and lifecycle workflows.
plugin: A plugin supplies hook templates, a validator, and a small workflow runner for chained actions.

ask: Discover, validate, update, and deploy plugins and local configuration.
plugin: A bin manager inventories installed plugins and settings, validates metadata, and applies scoped updates.

ask: Start, reconnect, filter, and expose MCP servers and tools reliably.
plugin: An MCP proxy and monitor supervise servers, retry calls, filter exposed tools, and report health.

ask: Run and supervise recurring or event-triggered local Claude tasks.
plugin: A bin scheduler launches Claude with project context; a monitor records results and retries safely.

ask: Alert when Claude needs input, stalls, or finishes a task.
plugin: A monitor watches process and transcript state and sends local notifications with links to the session.

ask: Clean temporary and cache files without touching active sessions.
plugin: A monitor inventories stale Claude temporary files and cache directories, then removes verified orphans.

ask: Control answer brevity, structure, tone, and output formatting.
plugin: An output style and skill specify response length, format, and audience with per-project configuration.

ask: Search large repositories with indexed code intelligence.
plugin: An MCP or LSP server indexes symbols and repository text and exposes scoped search tools.

ask: Control browser tabs and local previews from Claude Code.
plugin: An MCP server exposes tab management, browser automation, and local HTML preview tools.

ask: Give Claude Code context from editors and debuggers.
plugin: An MCP or LSP server exposes workspace roots, selections, debugger frames, and editor actions.

ask: Generate visual assets during coding tasks.
plugin: An MCP server connects an image generation service and saves generated assets into the project.

ask: Run scoped development jobs on SSH and scheduler hosts.
plugin: An MCP server submits jobs through SSH and Slurm or PBS and returns logs and artifacts.

ask: Convert and validate additional structured data formats.
plugin: An MCP server parses and emits the requested data format with validation and compact results.

ask: Review pull and merge requests across code hosts.
plugin: An MCP server fetches Bitbucket or GitLab review context and a review agent posts scoped findings.

ask: Diagnose and restore local MCP server connections.
plugin: A monitor supervises MCP processes and a proxy reconnects after disconnects with health diagnostics.

ask: Control which MCP tools enter the model context.
plugin: A proxy inventories tools, filters by policy, and exposes deferred discovery with compact results.

ask: Test proposed edits before accepting them.
plugin: A command applies a proposed patch to a disposable worktree, runs checks, and presents a diff for acceptance.

ask: Give Claude Code question dialogs more choices and safer response controls.
plugin: Experimental function hooks customize question UI options and input timing.

ask: Set safe limits and context for parallel agents.
plugin: A dispatch skill and monitor cap concurrent agents, attach project context, and record per-agent resource use.

ask: Start Claude Code with project-specific directory, environment, and tool settings.
plugin: A bin launcher selects the project root and scoped environment before invoking Claude Code.

ask: Apply file edits against stable line anchors.
plugin: An MCP editing tool validates content hashes before applying patches and reports conflicts for review.

ask: Let Claude inspect images from local files and tool results.
plugin: An MCP server loads image files or image blocks, extracts visual content, and returns a concise description.

ask: Start and inspect local Claude Code tasks through an API.
plugin: A bin daemon exposes authenticated HTTP task submission and status endpoints backed by local Claude runs.
